recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further FHIR-core work is only warranted if PA explicitly reopens the current Appointment.supportingInformation or HealthcareService.program search parameter codes.
issue_request: FHIR-13808 requested aligned search parameters across Schedule, Slot, Appointment, and HealthcareService: add service-category/specialty/service-type variants for scheduling resources, add Slot appointment-type, add Appointment reason and supporting-information search capability based on FHIR-18829, and rename HealthcareService type/category/programname search parameters.
initial_application: Git history shows explicit application in 28a69ce87d75315e2ba423a04c9e1f9e717b9a75, whose subject cites GF#13808 and updated the historical Schedule and Slot spreadsheet sources. The later source rework in 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 added the current bundle-*-search-params.xml files for Appointment, HealthcareService, Schedule, and Slot.
additional_context: The affected resources are active/approved in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-18829 is the referenced Appointment/Encounter reason-modeling decision and supports the current reason-code/reason-reference parameters. FHIR-19357 later changed HealthcareService.programName to program CodeableConcept, explaining why the current token search parameter is program rather than a literal program-name. Current Appointment uses the code supporting-info for Appointment.supportingInformation, which preserves the requested search capability without introducing an outdated duplicate name.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source bundles contain Schedule service-category/service-type/specialty; Slot appointment-type/service-category/service-type/specialty; Appointment service-category/specialty/reason-code/reason-reference/supporting-info; and HealthcareService coverage-area/program/service-category/service-type/specialty.
